items.title: Cloudflare security-audit-skill
items.signal: 11,908 stars this week shown at observation. The repository describes multi-stage audits and independently verified findings.
items.possibility: Investigate whether a small team can distinguish actionable findings from duplicates or unsupported reports.
items.limit: Another security scanner would duplicate existing work. A remaining user problem and safe evaluation data still need verification.

items.title: Manufacturing AI without a large IT team

items.possibility: Find a specific factory-office task where a small model and review process beat a broad agent platform.
items.limit: Self-reported results, no independent validation. Event date is not the post publication date; exact post date remains unverified.
